newsitem.title: USA: Kmart November same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Kmart November same-store sales up.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Thursday that on a comparable-store basis, consolidated sales rose 4.1 percent in the four weeks ended November 27, compared with the four weeks ended November 22, 1995.
November sales in the U.S. Kmart stores increased 4.4 percent on a comparable-store basis.
Total sales for the month from consolidated operations were $2.91 billion, up 2.7 percent from sales of $2.83 billion for the same period last year.

Sales from consolidated operations for the 43 weeks ended November 27 were $26.65 billion, down 0.2 percent from $26.69 billion for the first 43 weeks of 1995. On a comparable-store basis, U.S. Kmart stores' sales rose 2.5 percent for the period.

"Kmart's sales performance improved during the month," Floyd Hall, chairman, said in a statement. "Sales were led by the consumables area, followed by improved performance in hardlines. Our softlines performance was on plan."
Areas showing particular strength for the month included soft home, men's and children's apparel, hard home, electronics, consumables, pharmacy, and health and beauty aids, Hall added.

Among Kmart's operations, international same-store sales in November were up 10.4 percent. Total general merchandise same-store sales gained 4.6 percent for the month. Builders Square November same-store sales fell 2.9 percent.
